prompt: On the live map, what does a red pin indicate about a branch?
choices: The branch is offline
The branch is safe
The branch is at risk
The branch is in a critical state

prompt: What happens when you click a branch marker on the map?
choices: A new container is created at that branch
The map zooms in and the container list filters to that branch
The page navigates to the branch settings
All filters are reset to default

prompt: What does the Cryocan page show you about a container?
choices: Only the refill schedule and billing records
A live 3D model, real-time sensor tiles, trend charts, and operational logs
Branch configuration and user access settings
Shipment tracking and delivery status only

prompt: What should the internal temperature of a healthy cryogenic container stay near?
Why is tracking the external temperature alongside the internal temperature useful?
choices: It tells you the room humidity level
It helps determine whether a temperature excursion is environment-driven or equipment-driven
It controls the thermostat for the lab room
It records the shipping route ambient conditions

prompt: The LN2 Fill Level tile shows 100%. What does this mean?
choices: The tank is critically low and needs immediate refill
The sensor is offline and no reading is available
The tank is completely full
The threshold alert has been triggered

prompt: L2 point in the LN2 level indicates which of the following?
choices: The container is nearing its refill threshold
A lid left open, a seal failure, or unusual thermal load
The sensor battery is running low
The container has been moved to a new branch

prompt: What happens when the monitoring device battery drops to 0%?
choices: An automated refill is triggered
The container is flagged as critical on the map
Temperature and shock readings are no longer available until the device is recharged
The container is locked and cannot be opened

prompt: The Lid State tile turns red. What does this immediately signal?
choices: A refill was successfully completed
The container lid is open, and LN2 evaporation and sample integrity are at immediate risk
The lid sensor battery is low
A scheduled maintenance check is due

prompt: What can you do with the 3D cryocan model on the container page?
choices: Print a physical label for the tank
Drag to rotate it and click canisters inside to inspect patient samples and their storage status
Upload a new model image for the container
Lock the container remotely using the model controls

prompt: What does the System Activity feed record?
choices: Only LN2 refill events
Alerts fired, refills detected, tasks updated, configuration changes, and user logins — each timestamped and actor-tagged
Patient appointment schedules and billing logs
Network connectivity events for the monitoring device

prompt: After you acknowledge a critical alert, what happens to it?
choices: It is permanently deleted from the system
It is moved to a hidden archive only admins can see
It is moved out of the active queue but remains visible in the log for audit purposes
It reappears after 24 hours if not resolved

prompt: Who can see messages sent in the Stakeholder Chat for a container?
choices: Only the person who sent the message
Only branch managers
All stakeholders — doctors, embryologists, and lab coordinators
Only users with Admin role

prompt: What information does the My Tasks panel display for each task?
choices: Only the task name and due date
Task name, assignee, due date, priority, and status
Task name, container ID, and billing code
Only open tasks — completed tasks are hidden

prompt: The Quality Tracking Chart's 24H range shows a steep downward slope in LN2 level. What should you do?
choices: Switch to the LATEST range to confirm the sensor is online
Investigate for rapid evaporation and correlate the dip with the Refill Log to check whether a top-up already occurred
Acknowledge the chart as read and continue
Restart the monitoring device to reset the reading
